verdict.rationale: Attio documents a public read/write REST API backed by an OpenAPI 3.1 spec covering records, a rate-limiting guide (HTTP 429 with a Retry-After header), and signed webhooks that push real-time change events to a target URL, which supports change detection for bidirectional sync. Upsert semantics and bulk or at-scale sync patterns are not evidenced, and the rate-limit evidence describes response behavior rather than actual quotas. Missing for 10: documented upsert (assert/match-on-key) endpoints, concrete rate-limit numbers, bulk or batch operations for at-scale sync, independent or hands-on corroboration.
